_comment: Tier-2 Tukey HSD pairwise on region means after a one-way ANOVA. Step 1: GROUP_CATEGORY + AGG_AVERAGE + AGG_COUNT lay down per-region rows. Step 2: tier-1 TEST_ANOVA_F yields ms_within / df_within in its Details — those values are stamped into the TEST_TUKEY_HSD params so the post-test can compute studentized-range q statistics on the same Process call.
